messages:
Sam W: CI red on nightly, failing golden test in serializer tests (tests/renderer/test_prompt_outputs.py::test_prompt_roundtrip). Looks like output escaping/whitespace changed after PR #482. failing job: https://ci.redwood.dev/jobs/7890 :frowning:
Maria G: I touched serializer JSON escaping in #482. I ran unit tests locally and they passed. Did we change python deps? any env differences in CI? @Lee N any idea?
CI Bot: [ci/ nightly ] job 7890 failed — logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/jobs/7890/logs — snapshot diff artifact: gs://redwood-ci/artifacts/7890/prompt-diff.txt
Lee N: Quick check: run the failing test locally with the same env matrix used in CI. command:
```
tox -e py310 -- tests/renderer/test_prompt_outputs.py::test_prompt_roundtrip -k "roundtrip" -q
```
Also try with `PYTHONHASHSEED=0` and same env vars as CI.
Sam W: thx. I can try a rerun from here if that's easier.
Maria G: If rerun is cheap, do it. I suspect the snapshot has platform-specific ordering of keys in dict -> whitespace difference in pretty-printed JSON.
Asha P: If rerun fails, we should bisect between master and PR tip. quick bisect commands:
```
git fetch origin
git bisect start HEAD origin/main
git bisect good origin/main~5
# then checkout commits until failing commit identified
```
DevOps Pager: restarted job 7890 (manual restart). now watching :eyes:
Sam W: also pinging @engineering-review for a fast look at #482 in case we need to revert for the nightly. If rerun passes we can skip.
CI Bot: job 7890 rerun finished — status: PASSED. snapshot diffs show one small whitespace/escape change in test output; attached: gs://redwood-ci/artifacts/7890/prompt-diff.txt
Maria G: cool — looks like transient ordering during pretty-print on that runner. I'll add a normalization step in serializer to stable-key output and open a tiny follow-up patch.
Lee N: can you add a short unit that normalizes dict keys? quick patch will prevent recurrence.
Sam W: sounds good. closing the oncall alert. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
